description: Investigate homelab logs: status, tail, errors, search, timeline, and context over the log store.

action.description: Action to perform: status, tail, errors, search, timeline, context, or help.

bucket.description: Timeline bucket size: hour or day.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

query.description: Search text matched against log messages and sources.

since.description: Start of the time range, as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

source.description: Log source name to filter by.

timestamp.description: Timestamp or record index to center context results on.

until.description: End of the time range, as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

window_minutes.description: Time window in minutes around the timestamp for context results.

name: cortex
